item.title: RTT: Selection procedures for the recruitment of 2 RTT at the University of Salento (Univ. del SALENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-23 23:59
Institution: Univ. del SALENTO, Lecce
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-03 Chimica generale e inorganica

Selection procedures to fill two fixed-term tenure-track researcher (RTT) positions pursuant to Art. 24, paragraph 3, of Law no. 240 of 30 December 2010, reserved for holders of fixed-term researcher contracts—as referred to in Art. 24, paragraph 3, letter a) of the same Law (in the version in force prior to the entry into force of Law no. 79 of 29 June 2022; known as RTDA)—that are fully funded by PNRR resources and expire in 2025 or 2026: Academic Fields IINF-05/A and CHEM-03/A.
